title: DAT608 — POS Agent Fraud Detection
summary: A real-time fraud detection pipeline for Nigerian point-of-sale agent transactions, built on Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming, XGBoost + Isolation Forest (MLflow), FastAPI, ksqlDB and Streamlit as a DAT608 capstone at Pan-Atlantic University. Its models/synthetic_augmentation.py module runs SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata and conditional sampling to generate synthetic transaction data for training the fraud models.
